meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 当你要求搜 X/Twitter 时，Claude 会先确认 xAI 已连接，再用带日期范围和 since:/from: 等运算符的查询、拆成 2~3 次搜索，并与 web_search 结果对照，每条结论附上 x.com 链接。
howto.when: 当你提到「X 搜索」「Twitter 搜索」等社交信号需求，或要求查 X 上的帖子时触发；仅在 xAI 账号已连接、x_search 工具可用时生效。

howto.what_en: When you ask about X/Twitter, Claude checks that xAI is connected, then searches with date bounds and since:/from: operators, splits work into 2-3 calls, reconciles results with web_search, and cites the x.com URL for each claim.
howto.when_en: Triggers on X search, Twitter search, or posts on X requests; it only applies when an xAI account is connected and the x_search tool is available.

say_en.text: Search X for recent NVDA posts, links only
say_en.note: Date-bounds the query and drops replies
